snippet.title: DUNK Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re Katapult Games, and today we’re so hyped to finally share DUNK, our first-person, physics-driven basketball game for 1 to 6 players.

DUNK is all about fast, chaotic and social basketball. Intercept, pass, tackle and shoot your way through matches from 1v1 all the way up to 3v3. With proximity chat, unique courts and plenty of room for coordinated plays (and spectacular fails), every match plays out differently. Whether you’re pulling off a perfect alley-oop with your squad or giving your friends grief before tip-off, DUNK is built for playing with others.

We’ll be running open playtests very soon, and we want to hear what you think. Hit Request Access on the store page to sign up, and you’ll be among the first to get your hands on the game.

Request Access and Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4591520/DUNK/ 

Join the community!
Discord: https://discord.gg/e3eHaTTdPr 
X: https://x.com/DUNKthegame 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DUNKthegame/ 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@dunkthegame 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/DUNK.thegame
